mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate, indicating accommodative monetary policy, compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 and payrolls (PAYEMS) above 140000 signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the joint condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a CPIAUCSL above 235 signals accelerating inflation from a low base, which is associated with robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the CPIAUCSL threshold within the post-pandemic recovery regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16000) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 240) indicates a healthy economic expansion without overheating, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the joint condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic supply recovery regime, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals improving manufacturing capacity utilization, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 within the post-pandemic supply recovery regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
